newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures sharply higher after ECI, orders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures sharply higher after ECI, orders.

text.p: April 29 - U.S. debt futures were sharply higher in early trading, keying off weaker-than-expected ECI and durable goods orders. June T-bond soared to the highest price in almost 5 weeks in fast market trading. Sept Euro also spikes higher. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
